title: Anthropic S-1: post-IPO governance will retain Public Benefit Corporation status, giving its seven co-founders 50.1% voting control via a single Class F share (Deborah Mary Sophia/Reuters)
summary: Deborah Mary Sophia / Reuters: Anthropic S-1: post-IPO governance will retain Public Benefit Corporation status, giving its seven co-founders 50.1% voting control via a single Class F share — Anthropic unveiled its US initial public offering paperwork on Monday, setting up for a blockbuster market debut …
